buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work for contractors: Job includes the following: S.No Description 1.0 Assistance in servicing of attachment joints, including cleaning, lubrication/g reasing and assistance in servicing of bucket pins, bushes, hinge pins, hinge 1. s and other related joints of hydraulic excavators. 0 2.0 Assistance in removal, shifting, handling and fitment of machine aggregates and components, including hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic hoses, PTOs, gearb oxes, hydraulic pumps, compressors, radiators, coolers, engines, batteries a nd other mechanical, hydraulic and structural assemblies during repair/main tenance/overhauling. 3.0 Assistance in handling and fitment of mechanical, hydraulic and structural c omponents and spare parts, including OEM/reconditioned components, of hy draulic excavators, drills and other HEMM, as directed by departmental tech nical personnel. 4.0 Cleaning and assistance in tightening/torque of bolts and fasteners of HEMM , including track roller bolts, track chain bolts, H-frame bolts, sprocket bolts, idler bolts and other structural fasteners, under the supervision of skilled/tec hnical personnel.

5.0 Topping-up of lubricants, coolant and hydraulic oil and carrying out greasing /lubrication of hydraulic excavators, drills and other HEMM as per instruction s and prescribed maintenance practices. 6.0 Loading, unloading, lifting, shifting and transportation/handling of materials and components, including spare parts, lubricants, D.A./Oxygen cylinders, b atteries, tools, consumables, used oil and other maintenance materials betw een Stores, Field Machinery Section, CBRS, Auto-Shop, repair/workshop facili ties and job sites, including vice-versa movement. 7.0 Assistance in removal and replacement of bucket wear parts, including buck et tooth points, adapters, lock pins, bushes and other associated wear comp onents of hydraulic excavators. 8.0 Cleaning of machine tanks and cooling system components, including diesel tanks, hydraulic oil tanks, radiators, coolers and other associated componen ts of excavators and drills, as directed by the departmental personnel. 9.0 Removal, handling and shifting assistance for batteries, PTOs, engines, radi ators, coolers, hydraulic cylinders, compressors and other major/sub-assem blies from excavators and drills to the Field Machinery Section, Auto-Shop, r epair shop, CBRS or other designated locations and back. 10.0 Assistance in removal and shifting of compressors, hydraulic cylinders, PTOs and other sub-assemblies to the Field Machinery Section/repair shop for insp ection, repair, overhauling or maintenance. 11.0 Collection, handling and shifting of used oil, scrap and unserviceable compo nents/sub-assemblies generated during maintenance and repair activities to the designated storage/disposal location, as directed by the Engineer-in-Cha rge. 12.0 Assistance in general maintenance activities, including cleaning, preparation , handling of tools and materials, dismantling/assembly assistance, compon ent shifting and other auxiliary activities associated with repair and mainten ance of hydraulic excavators, drills and other HEMM. 13.0 The deployed semi-skilled manpower may be utilized interchangeably for m aintenance-support activities of hydraulic excavators, drills and other HEMM , as and when required and as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. 14.0 All activities involving technical repair, adjustment, testing, torquing to spec ified values, dismantling/assembly of critical components and other skilled o perations shall be carried out under the supervision/direction of qualified de partmental/skilled technical personnel. The semi-skilled workers shall provid e necessary assistance and shall not independently undertake specialized r epair or diagnostic work.

15.0 The manpower shall perform all allied and incidental support activities reaso nably required for efficient maintenance, repair, servicing, overhauling, shift ing, handling and upkeep of hydraulic excavators, drills and other HEMM, as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
